description: Keys whose pt-BR text may stay the same as the English text: texts that are the same in both languages (codec names, key names, numbers), and the texts that were not translated yet when tests/tools/i18n-check.js was added. Every key added later needs a Brazilian Portuguese translation. Remove a key from this list once it is translated.
keys: Apply the optimal streaming settings for this TV
- Recovers from packet loss without a full keyframe, which avoids traffic spikes and blurry frames. Disable it if artifacts remain after a frame drop.
Allow the host to recover lost frames with reference frame invalidation (HEVC and AV1)

- Passes the HDR metadata of the host display (peak brightness, color primaries) to the TV with every HEVC keyframe, so its HDR tone mapping matches the host. Disable it if HDR streams fail to start or look wrong.
Send the HDR metadata of the host to the TV (HEVC)
Video frame pacing on, limited color range, unlock all frame rates on, optimize bitrate presets off
The network connection type of the TV could not be detected, so a moderate bitrate will be applied.
Game mode stays disabled on Tizen %1$s, so install the ForceGM variant for the lowest latency.
Warning: The video decoder of the TV supports 4K up to 120 FPS, so higher frame rates at 4K may stutter or fail to start!
Warning: 90 FPS does not divide a 60 or 120 Hz output evenly, so motion may be less smooth than at 60 or 120 FPS!
Warning: Samsung TVs generally decode H.264 only up to 1080p, so use HEVC or AV1 for higher resolutions!
Warning: Reference frame invalidation is experimental. If artifacts remain after a frame drop, disable it again!
Warning: HDR static metadata is experimental. If HDR streams fail to start or look wrong, disable it again!
